title: Optimizing Legal Operations to Ensure a Frictionless Client Experience
summary: Discover how General Legal streamlines legal operations with AI, transparent flat-fee pricing, and fast client support for a frictionless experience.
body_markdown:
If you read our CPO JP Mohler’s recent piece on[why we built a law firm](https://general.legal/blog/we-build-for-clients) , you already know our core thesis: we are entirely obsessed with client outcomes, not preserving legacy legal workflows.


But as someone who sits in Client Operations handling success and billing here at[General Legal](https://general.legal/) , I look at that obsession through a slightly different lens.


While our engineers and attorneys are busy leveraging frontier AI stacks to turn around commercial contracts in hours instead of weeks, my job is to ensure that everything *after* the legal work feels just as seamless, fast, and respectful of your time.


## Key Takeaways


- General Legal's Client Operations lens: everything **after** the legal work - answers and billing - should feel as **fast and frictionless** as the legal work itself.
- Clients ping over **Slack** and get **real-time answers from experienced attorneys** , with no junior-associate database digging and no hourly meter running.
- Billing runs on **Stripe with flat-fee, per-matter pricing** (like a **$500** contract negotiation), so paying takes seconds instead of auditing a 20-page invoice sent 30 days late.
- The result is a **95% Client Satisfaction (CSAT) score** , in an industry where outside counsel is usually seen as the bottleneck.


## Answers in real time, not in days


Traditional outside counsel has made a habit of hiding behind the opaque wall of the billable hour, making simple answers take days and invoicing feel like an exercise in financial anxiety. We think that’s an incredibly broken way to treat founders and operators.


Because we operate as an AI-native firm, we’ve completely eliminated the friction of the intake-to-answer pipeline. When a client pings us via Slack our experienced attorneys deliver precise, real-time answers right away. No waiting for a junior associate to search a dusty database, and no paying for the time it takes them to do it.


## Billing that takes seconds, not an audit


That same commitment to radical efficiency extends directly to how we bill. We have integrated Stripe to automatically send direct, transparent invoices straight to our clients for our outcome-based, flat-fee pricing per matter. Traditional law firms love to send confusing, 20-page line-item PDFs thirty days late, forcing your finance team to audit why they were charged $150 for a five-minute phone call. With our transparent pricing structure and direct Stripe invoicing, paying for your legal services takes seconds. You get[clear, predictable flat fees](https://general.legal/pricing) -like our standard $500 contract negotiations—delivered straight to your inbox via an invoice. It turns billing from an administrative headache into an afterthought.


**** **Traditional outside counsel** **General Legal**


**Getting an answer** Days, via email and junior-associate research Real time, via Slack from experienced attorneys


**Pricing model** Billable hours Flat fee per matter (e.g. $500 contract negotiation)


**Invoicing** 20-page line-item PDFs, often sent 30 days late Direct, transparent Stripe invoice, paid in seconds


**Client satisfaction** Usually seen as a deal bottleneck 95% CSAT


Ultimately, we measure the success of these operational choices using the only metric that actually matters: whether our clients love working with us.


Right now, our **Client Satisfaction (CSAT) score sits at a remarkable 95%.**


In an industry where outside counsel is usually viewed as a bottleneck to closing deals, a 95% CSAT tells us that our combination of elite human judgment and automated operations is working.


We aren’t just making legal advice better, faster, and cheaper; we’re building a firm where the **operational reality finally matches the speed of the businesses we serve.**

**The problem** Traditional firms hide behind the billable hour: slow answers and confusing, late invoices.

## Conclusion


The legal work is only half the experience. The other half is everything around it: how fast you get an answer, and how painless it is to pay for it.


If you are tired of opaque hourly billing, slow email threads, and administrative bottlenecks, it is time to experience legal counsel built for the way you operate. Head over to our homepage and click[Get Started](https://general.legal/) to set up your account and connect your team with our operations today.


## ‍Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


### What does a "frictionless client experience" mean at General Legal?


It means the work around the legal work, getting answers and paying invoices, is as fast and painless as the legal work itself. Questions are answered in real time over Slack, and billing is a transparent flat fee sent through Stripe.


### How quickly does General Legal answer client questions?


In real time. Clients message over Slack and get precise answers from experienced attorneys right away, with no wait for a junior associate to research and no charge for the time it takes.


### How does General Legal bill clients?


Through flat-fee, per-matter pricing invoiced automatically via Stripe. A standard contract negotiation is $500, sent straight to the client's inbox, so payment takes seconds rather than an audit of a long line-item PDF.


### What is a CSAT score, and what is General Legal's?


CSAT (Client Satisfaction) measures how happy clients are with a service. General Legal's currently sits at 95%, unusually high for outside counsel.


### How is this different from a traditional law firm's operations?


Traditional firms often make simple answers take days and send confusing invoices weeks late. General Legal removes both frictions with real-time Slack answers and transparent, flat-fee Stripe billing.
